scope: Independent inspection of production browser PNGs and reports; no production files authored by this reviewer

firefox.qualification: The scrollbar assertion accepted an empty unsupported pseudo-element value; this report does not prove correct Firefox scrollbar styling.

chromium.failure: Shift+Tab from the close control leaves the modal focus loop

accepted_direction: A restrained common navy/brass control system improves hierarchy while retaining the SpriteCook world and icon family.
Rendered dialog frames no longer contain stretched corner bolts or horizontal separators crossing their outer frame.
Home has one obvious primary action and consistent secondary dock heights.
Reviewed library, settings, login, help, archive, inventory and learning screenshots retain readable Russian typography and coherent controls.
Loading and failure states keep the station navigation present and explain a concrete next action.

required_changes.issue: Programmatic focus draws a gold rectangle around the noninteractive home heading, competing with the primary action.
required_changes.acceptance: Heading still receives route focus for accessibility, without a button-like outline; keyboard control focus remains visible.

required_changes.issue: Guest sign-in and exit controls touch with no gap, and duplicated navigation dominates the profile dialog.
required_changes.acceptance: A spaced, wrapping action group gives sign-in clear priority; redundant home navigation is reduced.

required_changes.issue: Modal keyboard focus escapes in Chromium.
required_changes.acceptance: Tab and Shift+Tab wrap inside the open modal; close, Escape and backdrop restore its real opener.

required_changes.issue: The route card squeezes the narrow-screen title and description into approximately 90 px because icon and right action occupy the same row.
required_changes.acceptance: The action moves below the text on narrow screens; the title and body use the remaining width without one-word columns.

required_changes.issue: Firefox scrollbars remain gray and unthemed. The WebKit feature query resets scrollbar-color to auto; unsupported pseudo-element computed values are empty and falsely pass the test.
required_changes.acceptance: Firefox receives the station track/thumb colors and the test rejects auto plus empty pseudo-element values. New screenshots must demonstrate the resulting native shape and integrated position.

required_changes.issue: The word «самостоятельно» escapes the second summary card into its neighbor on the 390 px journal.
required_changes.acceptance: A concise label or wider layout fits inside the card; inner element overflow is checked.

followup_notes: World corner brackets are intentional selected-building graphics in HubR01Layer.drawMarkers. Verify clearing on pointer leave before deciding whether there is a stale hover state.
Remove remaining redundant negative boilerplate in the codebook examples and implementation-only font/package wording from ordinary user flows without changing scientific meaning.
The 844×390 blitz is vertically long; a compact landscape layout would keep timed work closer to its timer. This predates R05 and is recorded separately from the six required corrections.
final_acceptance: BLOCKED pending new browser evidence for the corrected candidate
